messages:
maria-ops: quick follow-up from PM-2026 postmortem — we need a focused runbook audit and small playbook patches. goal: cut mean triage time by 50% and codify recurring mitigations. posting owners + suggested changes here. :memo:
lee-oncall: can someone add a one-page triage checklist that an oncall can run in <10m? the last incident spent too long finding traces.
nina-eng: I can take that. will draft a 6-step checklist and include exact commands to grab tenant+trace context.
omar-ml: I'll add model/kv-cache checks and fallback steps (including what to do when warm-start regressions appear).
chris-platform: I'll update escalation rules in the playbook (who to page for infra vs runtime vs platform) and add a tiny paging matrix.
lee-oncall: checklist idea (short):
1) cluster status: `kubectl get nodes && kubectl get pods -n inference`
2) recent failures: `kubectl logs -l app=inference -n inference --since=15m --tail=200`
3) request traces by tenant: `redwoodctl traces query --tenant 67890 --since 20m`
4) cache health: `redwoodctl cache stats --model tut-model --window 5m`
5) if evictions spike >30% -> `redwoodctl cache pause --route <route>` then escalate to eng-runtime
6) toggle fallback if available: `redwoodctl route fallback --route <route> --to cpu-backend --kv-preserve`
maria-ops: nice. nina please include the exact redwoodctl flags and a sample command that includes tenant extraction (we had to ask product devs for IDs mid-incident).
nina-eng: sample snippet added to PR: `TENANT=$(kubectl get pod -l app=ingestion -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.labels.tenant}') && redwoodctl traces query --tenant $TENANT --since 30m`
omar-ml: model guidance: if fallback to CPU is used, run a rolling fallback with `--kv-preserve` and stagger by 30s per replica to avoid cold-start thundering herd. also add a quick heuristic: model-regression if token-latency increases >2x and error-rate stable -> likely cache issue.
chris-platform: escalation bullets: :warning:
- page eng-runtime on P1 or sustained error-rate >7% for 10m
- page infra for node OOMs, GPU ECC/driver errors, or host-level alerts
- page platform-owner for multi-region or multi-tenant impact
I'll attach rotation phone numbers and a copyable paging matrix in the playbook.
incident-bot: Reminder: link ticket IDs for each action and add owners in the postmortem doc. Auto-reminder scheduled in 72h.
maria-ops: action items (add to board ST-9901):
- nina-eng: full triage checklist + tenant extraction snippet (due 2d)
- chris-platform: escalation matrix + paging copy (due 3d)
- omar-ml: model-specific mitigations + fallback procedure (due 3d)
- maria-ops: customer timeline blurb for incident note + handoff plan (due 4d)
please include a 1-line test/validation step in each PR so oncall can verify.
nina-eng: opening PR: https://git.redwood/runbooks/inference-triage PR title: "inference: add 10m triage checklist + tenant snippets". test: run checklist against staging and paste output.
omar-ml: PR: https://git.redwood/runbooks/model-mitigations - includes stagger script and `--kv-preserve` guidance. test: simulate fallback in canary.
chris-platform: PR: https://git.redwood/runbooks/paging-matrix - will include CSV export of rotations.
maria-ops: recurring pattern note: ingestion-service large batch imports precede cache thrash in ~60% of recent incidents. suggested playbook add: temporary ingestion throttle + ingress backpressure step.
lee-oncall: suggested emergency throttle command: `kubectl scale deploy/ingestion-service --replicas=0 -n ingestion` (short stop) then `kubectl scale --replicas=1` after safe window. add safe rollback steps.
chris-platform: instead of stop, prefer temp rate-limit: `kubectl exec deploy/ingestion-configurator -n ingestion -- /bin/sh -c "set-rate-limit --route /uploads 10/s"` — we'll add both options and note risk.
maria-ops: good. final request before we merge: each PR add a 1-line summary, a link to the postmortem PM-2026, and a single test command. i'll run a 30-minute walk-through next Tue for oncall. meeting owner: maria-ops. :calendar:
lee-oncall: ack. will join and help with demo.
incident-bot: Ticket ST-9901 created for runbook audit. Actions assigned and reminders set.
maria-ops: thanks team — once PRs are merged please paste links here and mark done.
